# Camp Resource: Soul Soup Server

__Soul Soup Server__

*"Bring that 'Home Sweet Home' taste to the Vault with the Soul Soup Server!"*

__Overview__

A decorative CAMP resource that passively generates herbivore-friendly soup buffs. Requires no power and can be locked. Ideal for Herbivore builds looking for AP regen, carry weight, and perception boosts on the go.

## **__Function__**

__Function__

| **Item Produced** | **Drop Rate** | **Duration** | **Base Effect** | **Herbivore Effect** | **Herbivore + SIN Effect** |
| Brain Fungus Soup | 8% | 30 min | +2 INT | +4 INT | +5 INT |
| Corn Soup | 15.65% | 30 min | +3 AP Regen | +6 AP Regen | +8 AP Regen |
| Firecap Soup | 5.22% | 30 min | +25 Energy Resist | +50 Energy Resist | +63 Energy Resist |
| Pumpkin Soup | 25.5% | 30 min | +2 PER | +4 PER | +5 PER |
| Silt Bean Soup | 18.4% | 30 min | +2 END | +4 END | +5 END |
| Swamp Tofu Soup | 27.23% | 60 min | +0.25 HP/sec regen | +0.5 HP/sec regen | +0.62 HP/sec regen |

- Production Rate: 1 item every 10 minutes and 12 seconds
- Power Required: No
- Lockable: Yes

__Build Information__

- CAMP Build Limit: 1 per camp
- Workshop Build Limit: 1 per workshop
- Shares Build Limit With: None
- Build Menu Category: Resources
- Shelter Use: No
- Flamingo Units (CAMP Budget Cost): 2

__Crafting Requirements__

- 4x Steel

__Capacity__

- Storage: Holds up to 2 pounds of Cooked Soup

__How to Unlock__

- Season Reward: Season 22 – X – Page X – X Tickets
- Tradeable: No
- Giftable: No

- N/A

__Build Restrictions__

- Cannot be built inside Shelters
- Only available while in CAMP Mode
